answers.core: This makes 2D skeleton animation systems even better, and Polygon2D being in the sub-tier of 2D skeleton is a common practice in the industry
answers.workaround: I've tried setting the top_level property to achieve a similar effect, but this property breaks all inheritance and display hierarchies, which prevents other scenes from moving when using this animation, and Polygon2D stays at its origin

title: Polygon2D, as a sublevel of the 2D skeleton, is not affected by both transformation and bone weight
